facts.c: E-Solution (Cambodia) Co., Ltd., the company operating FWCMS, charges a public service fee of USD 30 (KHR 122,500) per request for a new or extended work permit and employment card.
facts.q: plus USD 30 (KHR 122,500) per request for a new or extended work permit and employment card
v: USD 30 per new or extended permit (2016)

facts.c: E-Solution charges USD 30 (KHR 122,500) per foreign-labour quota request.
facts.q: public service fee of USD 30 (KHR 122,500) per quota request for foreign labor

facts.c: All FWCMS fees are paid through the bank system, and E-Solution collects MLVT's official fees at the same time.
facts.q: All fees must be paid through the bank system, and E-Solution will request and process the MOLVT’s official fees at the same time.

facts.c: A health check certificate from a clinic of the worker's choice must be certified by the Department of Occupational Health and Safety for USD 5 (KHR 20,400).
facts.q: it must be certified by the Department of Occupational Health and Safety for a fee of USD 5 (KHR 20,400)
